_comment: Irrigation flow watch (services/IrrigationFlowWatchService.js). English must stay identical to the pre-i18n texts. Optional fragments are separate keys; {extra}/{note}/... render empty when absent.

title.flow_above_expected: Irrigation: more flow than one zone
title.water_without_valve: Irrigation: flow with no zone open
title.retry_recovered: Irrigation recovered after a cold restart

fire.valve_no_flow: {label} is ON with the irrigation pump running, but no water is flowing: {flow} L/h for {dur}, expected ~{expected} L/h. Valve not opening? Check the zone valve (then the pump).
fire.low_flow: {label}: low flow — {flow} L/h is {pct} % of the expected ~{expected} L/h for {dur}. Valve partly open, blocked filter or pump problem?
fire.flow_above_expected: {label}: more water than one zone should take — {mean} L/h ({window} s average) vs ~{base} L/h for this zone (+{pct} %, limit +{limit} %, {basis}) for {dur}. Another valve may be open (manual override or bleed left open?).
fire.dosing_without_water: Fertiliser is dosing into a line with no water flow: {tanks} (water {flow} L/h, below {max} L/h for {dur}). {extra}
fire.water_without_valve: Water is flowing ({flow} L/h for {dur}) but no irrigation zone relay on {equipment} is ON — stuck-open valve, leak or a manual valve?
fire.water_without_valve_panel: Manual irrigation (panel) needs attention: {why}. Water {flow} L/h, started {start}, {water} L so far; {tanks}{ratio}. No SenseHub pump or zone relay is ON — check at the panel.
fire.manual_panel: Manual irrigation detected (panel) — water {flow} L/h, started {start}. No SenseHub pump or zone relay is ON, so the zone is unknown {hint} and dosing is outside SenseHub control. {extra}
fire.flow_after_pump_off: Water is flowing ({flow} L/h for {dur}) while the irrigation pump relay ({equipment} relay {channel}) is OFF — pump run by hand at the panel, or siphoning?
fire.monitor_blind: The irrigation pump is ON but water flow cannot be verified: {why}. Zone, low-flow and dosing checks are paused until it reports again.

blind.unhealthy: the flow meter is unhealthy (signal {signal}, error flags {flags}) for {dur}
blind.no_data: no data from the flow meter for {dur}

dosing.stop_disabled: Automatic dosing stop is OFF (abort_dosing_on_no_water = false) — stop dosing manually.
dosing.not_running: The injector valves are open but no dose cycle is running under the scheduler, so the flow watch cannot stop them — close them manually.

abort.closed_body: dose cycle{cycle} aborted by the flow watch, injector valves closed ({tanks}). Pumps and zone valves were not touched
abort.missing_body: dose cycle{cycle} aborted, but closing {tanks} was NOT confirmed — check the injector valves now
abort.already_ended: The dose cycle had already ended.
abort.failed: Automatic dosing stop FAILED ({error}) — stop the dose cycle and close the injector valves now.

end.valve_no_flow_recovered: Resolved: {label} — water flow recovered after {dur} with no flow (now {flow} L/h, expected ~{expected} L/h). The valve opened late.
end.valve_no_flow: {label} ran {dur} with no water flowing (lowest {min} L/h, expected ~{expected} L/h) until the zone/pump switched off at {time}. Check the zone valve before the next run.
end.low_flow_recovered: Resolved: {label} — flow back to {flow} L/h after {dur} of low flow.
end.low_flow_escalated: {label}: low flow turned into no flow after {dur} — see the no-flow alarm.
end.low_flow: {label} ran {dur} at low flow (lowest {min} L/h, expected ~{expected} L/h) until it switched off at {time}.
end.flow_above_expected_recovered: Resolved: {label} — flow back within +{pct} % of the zone baseline after {dur}.
end.flow_above_expected: {label} took more water than one zone for {dur} (highest {max} L/h, {baseline}) until the zone changed at {time}. Check for another valve left open.
end.dosing_recovered: Resolved: dosing without water ({tanks}) ended after {dur}: water flow recovered ({flow} L/h). {aborted} {litres}
end.dosing_had_been_stopped: Dosing had been stopped automatically (dose cycle aborted).
end.dosing: Dosing without water ({tanks}) lasted {dur}; {how}. {litres} Find out why there was no water flow before the next run.
end.litres: About {litres} L of concentrate went in with no water flow.
end.how_aborted_plain: dosing stopped automatically (the flow watch aborted the dose cycle)
end.panel_attention: Manual irrigation (panel) that needed attention ended at {time}: {dur}, {water} L, {tanks}{ratio}. Escalated because {why}.
end.water_without_valve_recovered: Resolved: water flow with no zone open stopped after {dur}.
end.water_without_valve: Water flowed with no zone open for {dur} until a zone opened at {time} (highest {max} L/h).
end.flow_after_pump_off_recovered: Resolved: water flow with the pump relay OFF stopped after {dur}.
end.flow_after_pump_off: Water flowed with the pump relay OFF for {dur} until the pump was switched on at {time} (highest {max} L/h).
end.monitor_blind_recovered: Resolved: flow meter data is back (was unverifiable for {dur}).
end.monitor_blind: Flow could not be verified for {dur} of pumping; the pump is now OFF. Check the irrigation monitor.

panel.why_dosing_low_flow: tanks still dosing ({litres} L in {dur}) with water below {max} L/h

retry.start_valve: {label} had no water for {dur} with the pumps running (flow {flow} L/h, below {threshold} L/h). Pumps and the zone valve switched off and dosing paused; cold restart of pumps + zone in {pause} s (retry {attempt} of {max}). {extra}
retry.start_pumps: {label} had no water for {dur} with the pumps running (flow {flow} L/h, below {threshold} L/h). Pumps switched off and dosing paused; cold restart of the pumps in {pause} s (retry {attempt} of {max}). {extra}
retry.dose_aborted: The dose cycle runs on a fixed schedule and cannot pause, so it was aborted: the rest of this run gets NO fertiliser.
retry.dose_failed: Pausing dosing FAILED ({error}) — check the injector valves.
retry.recovered_valve: {label} recovered after a cold restart (retry): no water for {dur} with the pumps running, so pumps and valve were stopped {pause} s and restarted — flow back to {flow} L/h {after} after the restart. {note} {dose} The valve sticks when switched under pressure — check it.
retry.recovered_pumps: {label} recovered after a cold restart (retry): no water for {dur} with the pumps running, so pumps were stopped {pause} s and restarted — flow back to {flow} L/h {after} after the restart. {note} {dose} Check the zone valve.
retry.superseded: {zone} was superseded by the next zone during the pause; pumps restarted for that zone.
retry.recovered_dose_aborted: Dosing had to be aborted (fixed schedule): no fertiliser for the rest of this run.
retry.recovered_dose_resumed: Dosing resumed with the zone target kept.
retry.abandoned: Cold restart cancelled: {why}. The pumps stay OFF.

why.retry_failed: the cold restart did not bring water
why.several_zones: more than one zone was open
why.no_pump_end: no planned pump end (not a scheduled run)
why.no_zone_end: no planned zone end (not a scheduled run)
why.too_little_left: only {seconds} s of the zone would be left after the pause
why.off_unconfirmed: the pumps could not be confirmed OFF for the retry ({error})
why.disarmed_in_pause: automations were disarmed during the retry pause (no restart)
why.automation_gone: the automation was disabled or deleted during the retry pause (no restart)
why.relays_unknown: the irrigation relay state was unknown at the restart
why.other_zone_opened: another zone opened while the stuck zone was still energised
why.too_little_left_at_restart: only {seconds} s of the zone were left at the restart
why.on_unconfirmed: the cold restart ON was not confirmed ({error})
why.pump_off_early: the pump switched off before water was confirmed
why.stop_pressed_restart: Stop irrigation was pressed during the restart
why.stop_pressed_restart_unconfirmed: Stop irrigation was pressed during the restart (OFF NOT confirmed)

shutdown.main: Irrigation stopped: {what} — pumps, zones and dosing switched off to prevent over-pressure. {retry} Zones not irrigated this run: {zones}. {check} ({outcome}.) {warning}
shutdown.what_zone: {label} had no water for {dur} with the pumps running
shutdown.what_no_zone: {label} ran with no zone open and no water flowing for {dur}
shutdown.retry_failed_valve: A cold restart (pumps + valve off {pause} s, then on again) did not bring water.
shutdown.retry_failed_pumps: A cold restart (pumps off {pause} s, then on again) did not bring water.
shutdown.check_no_zone: Check why no zone was open.

not_confirmed.one: WARNING: OFF NOT CONFIRMED on {equipment} relay {relays}{error} — press Stop All or switch the pumps off at the panel NOW.
not_confirmed.other: WARNING: OFF NOT CONFIRMED on {equipment} relays {relays}{error} — press Stop All or switch the pumps off at the panel NOW.

shutdown.off_unconfirmed_alert: Irrigation shutdown could not confirm the pumps/zones OFF on {equipment} (relays {relays}{error}). Press Stop All or switch the pumps off at the panel NOW.

relay_reason.stale: irrigation relay board state is stale
